source_document: NDMA public assessment: Bonthe District floods 3–5 September 2022
event_location_name: Bonthe District (Kwamebai Krim, Nongoba Bullom, Gbap, Yawbeko, Sogbini chiefdoms)
description: NDMA: 3–5 September 2022 torrential rain flooded many villages in five named chiefdoms. Relief cited 3,984 people. Named villages were not listed. Not exploded into invented community-day rows.

source_document: NDMA: Delken Village Floods assessment (published 15 Sep 2023)
description: NDMA: floods destroyed houses and livelihoods at Delken Village, Sittia Chiefdom, Bonthe District on 1 September 2023. 96 households / 724 people affected; 16 houses destroyed, 34 partially damaged. No death reported. Coordinates not published.

source_document: IFRC DREF Final Report MDRSL016 (date of event 23 Sep 2024)
description: IFRC: on 23 September 2024 overflow of the Bumbuna Dam caused severe flooding in downstream communities; 716 people displaced. NDMA nationwide note the same day lists Tonkolili chiefdoms Dansogoia and Kalantuba, not Bumbuna by name — discrepancy flagged, original IFRC wording preserved.

corroborating_sources.note: Confirms Tonkolili flooding in the same period. Does not name Bumbuna Dam overflow. Date/place discrepancy flagged, not overwritten.
